left_right_convention: LEFT/RIGHT CONVENTION (normative). Every 'left'/'right' in a region_id or label is the WEARER's left/right, i.e. the leg the wearer's own left leg goes into. On the FRONT drawing (garment laid front-up, waistband at top, camera overhead) the wearer's LEFT is at LARGE x (screen right, x > 200) and the wearer's RIGHT is at SMALL x (screen left, x < 200) -- you are looking at the garment as you would look at the person facing you. On the BACK drawing (same garment flipped over about its own vertical axis, back-up, waistband still at top) the wearer's LEFT is at SMALL x (screen left) and the wearer's RIGHT is at LARGE x. Consequence to expect and not to 'fix': hem_left_front and hem_right_back carry identical polygons, as do thigh_front_left and thigh_back_right, because the same outer silhouette edge swaps screen sides when the garment is turned over. The app must print the wearer-side word next to the highlight, never rely on which side of the screen it is on.
